page_title: BRE 2-5 PSG | Brest v PSG 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' 2 - 5 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:5.
90+3' Desire Doue (PSG) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

89' 2 - 4 Desire Doue is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 2:4.
88' Romain Faivre will be replaced by Ibrahim Salah (Brest).

88' Willian Pacho (PSG) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brest win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
86' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
85' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to PSG.
81' The substitution is prepared. Senny Mayulu (PSG) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kang-In Lee.
81' Benoit Bastien blows the whistle, Mama Balde (Brest) is penalised for a foul. PSG win a free kick.
79' Romain Faivre (Brest) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
79' The ball goes out for a corner. Brest can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Hugo Magnetti (Brest).
77' Substitution. Pierre Lees-Melou leaves the pitch and is replaced by Edimilson Fernandes (Brest).
76' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.

76' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Brest will take a corner.
75' A quickly taken corner by Brest.
73' Kang-In Lee (PSG) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper.
73' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Brest is cautioned for aggressive play. PSG will take a free kick.
71' 2 - 3 What a beauty from just outside the box! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
70' Here is a change. Abdallah Sima is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Mama Balde (Brest).
70' The substitution has been made. Kamory Doumbia (Brest) has replaced Romain Del Castillo.
69' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Achraf Hakimi (PSG).
67' Here comes a substitution. Bradley Barcola is given a rest as he is replaced by Lucas Hernandez (PSG).
67' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Goncalo Ramos (PSG) replacing Ousmane Dembele.
62' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Kang-In Lee tees up Ousmane Dembele (PSG) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Marco Bizot.
61' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) meets a cross inside the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
58' Substitution. Desire Doue (PSG) on for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
57' 1 - 2 Goal! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
56' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma keeps it out with an amazing save.
54' Bradley Barcola (PSG) latches on to a precise cross and hammers the ball goalwards, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
53' Bradley Barcola (PSG) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Brest have a free kick.

50' 1 - 1 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Gianluigi Donnarumma is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
50' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
49' The referee blows his whistle as Bradley Barcola (PSG) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Brest in a dangerous position.
46' Referee Benoit Bastien blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Brest fail to score from a corner as Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) leaps to collect the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is able to continue to play.
44' Bradley Barcola (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
36' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Abdallah Sima (Brest).
36' Abdallah Sima (Brest) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to PSG.

31' Romain Faivre (Brest) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert and denies him with a nice save.
29' 0 - 1 Goal Ousmane Dembele (PSG)! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) was put through by Bradley Barcola and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
29' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

29' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. PSG force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
28' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner with a short pass.

27' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
27' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
22' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

19' Bradley Barcola (PSG) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the right post and ricochets away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
17' A dangerous looking corner kick from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is cleared to safety by the defence.

16' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

15' Luc Zogbe (Brest) probably spotted the goalkeeper off his line, but he misdirected his long-range shot as it went a few yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.

13' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
9' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Gianluigi Donnarumma.
5' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Marco Bizot thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
4' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
